Question 2
?

Which integral gives the area of the finite region bounded by y=8x2−5 and y=1−2x, shown above?

(Note: Figure not drawn to scale)

a
∫−1/33/4(−x2−2x+6)dx
b
∫13/4(−8x2+x+5)dx
c
∫−1/43/4(−8x2−2x+1)dx
d
∫−13/4(8x2−x−4)dx
e
∫−13/4(−8x2−2x+6)dx
